en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a dramatic ski jump scene taking place in a snowy, forested area. A skier, likely a competitor, is airborne above the trees with spectators and a flag (appearing to be the Swedish flag) visible at the side of the ski jump. The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, a Swedish postage stamp with a portrait, and addresses written in cursive.
